requirements.quote:
Each owner name in the zone that has authoritative data or a
   delegation point NS RRset MUST have an NSEC resource record.
requirements.condition: An owner name in the zone has authoritative data.
requirements.required_behavior: The owner name MUST have an NSEC resource record.
requirements.why_checkable: The owner names of authoritative data can be compared with the owner names of NSEC records in the signed zone.

requirements.quote:
Each owner name in the zone that has authoritative data or a
   delegation point NS RRset MUST have an NSEC resource record.
requirements.condition: An owner name in the zone has a delegation point NS RRset.
requirements.required_behavior: The owner name MUST have an NSEC resource record.
requirements.why_checkable: Every delegation point NS RRset can be checked for an NSEC record at the same owner name.

requirements.quote:
The TTL value for any NSEC RR SHOULD be the same as the minimum TTL
   value field in the zone SOA RR.
requirements.condition: An NSEC resource record is included in a zone.
requirements.required_behavior: The NSEC RR TTL SHOULD equal the minimum TTL value field in the zone SOA RR.
requirements.why_checkable: The NSEC TTL and SOA minimum TTL field are directly comparable; a mismatch is a departure from a recommendation.

requirements.quote:
An NSEC record (and its associated RRSIG RRset) MUST NOT be the only
   RRset at any particular owner name.
requirements.condition: An owner name has an NSEC record and its associated RRSIG RRset.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The NSEC record and its associated RRSIG RRset MUST NOT be the only RRsets at that owner name.
requirements.why_checkable: The RRsets at each NSEC owner name can be enumerated to check for another RRset.

requirements.quote:
That is, the signing process
   MUST NOT create NSEC or RRSIG RRs for owner name nodes that were not
   the owner name of any RRset before the zone was signed.
requirements.condition: An owner name node was not the owner name of any RRset before the zone was signed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The signing process MUST NOT create NSEC RRs for that owner name node.
requirements.why_checkable: The owner names in the unsigned zone can be compared with the NSEC owner names created by signing.

requirements.quote:
That is, the signing process
   MUST NOT create NSEC or RRSIG RRs for owner name nodes that were not
   the owner name of any RRset before the zone was signed.
requirements.condition: An owner name node was not the owner name of any RRset before the zone was signed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The signing process MUST NOT create RRSIG RRs for that owner name node.
requirements.why_checkable: The owner names in the unsigned zone can be compared with the RRSIG owner names created by signing.

requirements.quote:
The type bitmap of every NSEC resource record in a signed zone MUST
   indicate the presence of both the NSEC record itself and its
   corresponding RRSIG record.
requirements.condition: An NSEC resource record is in a signed zone.
requirements.required_behavior: Its type bitmap MUST indicate the presence of the NSEC record itself.
requirements.why_checkable: The NSEC bit can be inspected in every NSEC record type bitmap.

requirements.quote:
The type bitmap of every NSEC resource record in a signed zone MUST
   indicate the presence of both the NSEC record itself and its
   corresponding RRSIG record.
requirements.condition: An NSEC resource record is in a signed zone.
requirements.required_behavior: Its type bitmap MUST indicate the presence of its corresponding RRSIG record.
requirements.why_checkable: The RRSIG bit can be inspected in every NSEC record type bitmap.

requirements.quote:
RRSIG records are present at the
   owner names of all authoritative RRsets.
requirements.condition: An RRset is authoritative data in the signed zone.
requirements.required_behavior: RRSIG records are present at the owner name of the authoritative RRset.
requirements.why_checkable: The owner names of authoritative RRsets can be checked for the presence of RRSIG records.

requirements.quote:
Neither NSEC nor RRSIG records are
   present (in the parent zone) at the owner names of glue address
   RRsets.
requirements.condition: An owner name belongs to a glue address RRset in the parent zone.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include NSEC records at that glue address RRset owner name in the parent zone.
requirements.why_checkable: The parent zone can be inspected to ensure glue address owner names do not carry NSEC records.

requirements.quote:
Neither NSEC nor RRSIG records are
   present (in the parent zone) at the owner names of glue address
   RRsets.
requirements.condition: An owner name belongs to a glue address RRset in the parent zone.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include RRSIG records at that glue address RRset owner name in the parent zone.
requirements.why_checkable: The parent zone can be inspected to ensure glue address owner names do not carry RRSIG records.

requirements.quote:
Note, however, that this distinction is for the most part
   visible only during the zone signing process, as NSEC RRsets are
   authoritative data and are therefore signed.  Thus, any owner name
   that has an NSEC RRset will have RRSIG RRs as well in the signed
   zone.
requirements.condition: An NSEC RRset is present in a signed zone.
requirements.required_behavior: The NSEC RRset is signed, with RRSIG RRs present at its owner name.
requirements.why_checkable: The NSEC signing path and the presence of RRSIG records at each NSEC owner name can be checked.

requirements.condition: An NSEC RR is at a delegation point.
requirements.required_behavior: The bit corresponding to the delegation NS RRset MUST be set in the NSEC bitmap.
requirements.why_checkable: The NS bit in each delegation point NSEC bitmap can be inspected.

requirements.condition: An NSEC RR is at a delegation point, and the parent zone has authoritative data for an RRset there.
requirements.required_behavior: The bit corresponding to that authoritative RRset MUST be set in the NSEC bitmap.
requirements.why_checkable: The bitmap bits can be compared with the types for which the parent zone has authoritative data at the delegation.

requirements.quote:
The bitmap for the NSEC RR at a delegation point requires special
   attention.  Bits corresponding to the delegation NS RRset and any
   RRsets for which the parent zone has authoritative data MUST be set;
   bits corresponding to any non-NS RRset for which the parent is not
   authoritative MUST be clear.
requirements.condition: An NSEC RR is at a delegation point, and the parent is not authoritative for a non-NS RRset there.
requirements.required_behavior: The bit corresponding to that non-NS RRset MUST be clear in the NSEC bitmap.
requirements.why_checkable: Non-NS RRset types outside the parent authority can be checked for clear bits in the delegation NSEC bitmap.
